question: Why do unperfected yogis fail to see the self despite striving?
premises: striving yogis see the self established in self
unperfected selves do not see it
effort alone is insufficient without ripeness
inference: Seeing the self requires perfected inner condition, not mere effort or initiation.
uncertainties: long compounds retained as fused surfaces
plain_english: Striving yogis see the self established in the self, but unperfected selves do not; effort alone does not yield fullness.
